summary: Applied all three blocking spec review findings to requirements, acceptance criteria, overview decisions, constraints, and tasks.

items.title: Non-base presets still resolve from bundled artifacts as built-ins
items.rationale: The spec now requires core built-ins to come only from src/presets/base and requires tests proving non-base official presets are unavailable until the sibling-sourced plugin is enabled.
items.evidence: spec.json constraints, R3, acceptance_criteria, overview.decisions, and task T-3 now cover enabled-plugin-only non-base preset resolution.

items.title: Official upgrade path is not tied to the committed sibling source
items.rationale: The spec now requires official upgrade to validate clean sibling Git roots, copy from pinned HEAD, and reject dirty/non-Git/missing-HEAD sources before writing plugin.packages.
items.evidence: spec.json constraints, R4, acceptance_criteria, overview.decisions, and task T-4 now cover committed-source materialization and dirty source rejection.

items.title: Workflow plugin artifact lacks an execution acceptance basis
items.rationale: The spec now requires a temporary project to run an installed sibling-sourced workflow command entry point so manifest completeness alone cannot pass.
items.evidence: spec.json R5, acceptance_criteria, overview.data_flow, overview.decisions, and task T-5 now cover installed workflow command execution.
